name: Glitch wall punctuates the spiral
looks: A single word repeats full-bleed in torn horizontal bands, the colour channels split and fringing, the whole frame juddering out of alignment for less than a second before it cuts hard to black.
build: chroma-split-glitch-wall: three colour copies of the repeated word offset per frame, the frame sliced into bands each with its own re-rolled jitter; cut out hard, no fade.
sound: A harsh digital stutter that cuts off sharply on the hard cut to black.
prompt: Punctuate a build-up of tension with one short, harsh beat: repeat a single word full-bleed in torn, colour-split bands for under a second, then cut hard to black, so the overload reads as a system breaking rather than a style choice.
